notice.markersRemoved.other: Removed {count} continuation markers, such as (MORE) and (CONT’D). Pagework adds them where the pages break.

bar.label: Elements
product.name: Pagework
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.localHint: Scripts stay in this browser and in files you save. Nothing is sent to this server.
setup.title: Set up Pagework
setup.intro: Create the account you’ll sign in with. It will also be the server’s administrator.
setup.codeHint: In the server’s log, on the line that starts “Pagework isn’t set up yet”.
password.changed: Password changed. Anywhere else this account was signed in has been signed out.
password.required: Your administrator has asked you to choose a new password before you carry on.
account.title: Account
unreachable.title: Can’t reach the server
error.offline: You’re offline. Connect to the internet to sign in, or use Pagework without an account.
error.unreachable: The server isn’t answering. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
error.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps happening, the server’s log says what failed.
error.unknown: The server refused that. Try again; if it keeps happening, the server’s log says why.
error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don’t match an account. Check them and try again.
error.too_many_attempts.one: Too many attempts. Try again in 1 minute.
error.too_many_attempts.other: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
error.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Ask the server’s administrator to enable it.
error.invalid_setup_code: That setup code isn’t right. Copy it from the server’s log, from the line that starts “Pagework isn’t set up yet”.
error.already_set_up: This server is already set up. Sign in with the account created then.
error.invalid_email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
error.password_too_short: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.
error.password_too_long: Choose a password of at most 256 characters.
error.field_too_long: One of the entries is too long. Shorten it and try again.
error.signed_out: You’ve been signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
error.cross_origin: That request didn’t come from this server’s address. Open Pagework at its usual address and try again.
error.csrf_token: Your session changed in another tab. Reload the page and try again.
